searchText: what kind of strange behavior? failed txs which we have no explanation for (these were working yesterday) e.g. https://ropsten.etherscan.io/tx/0x51000f166ff022ec7e4886ee8162dce8488061114b1765a93c7546e706aba5d9, also bunch of issues with etherscan thinking many storage fields are 0 even though they shouldn't be e.g. ETH_ADDRESS here is a non-zero constant https://ropsten.etherscan.io/address/0x17dabab2a55572a6810d06464baafa746963b73c#readContract <@!542045934360461313> could it maybe be caused by https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3529 ? not sure I see how Yeah, it’s the only one I can see which would affect the validity of a txn. Maybe with a trace of the txn someone could spot where it’s going wrong? in case anyone has any ideas: https://ethtx.info/ropsten/0x51000f166ff022ec7e4886ee8162dce8488061114b1765a93c7546e706aba5d9 😜 <vbuterin> Hmm EIP 3529 only reduces refunds, how could it make txs no longer work?
